preamble: Chapter rule 1: Any good of chapter 37 that is a product of a chemical reaction, as defined in subdivision (n)(v) of this note, shall be considered to be an originating good if the chemical reaction occurred in the territory of Singapore or of the United States.

rules.text: A change to headings 3701 through 3703 from any heading outside that group.
A change to headings 3704 through 3706 from any other heading, including another heading within that group.
A change to subheadings 3707.10 through 3707.90 from any other subheading, including another subheading within that group.
